title: Roadmap - Releases, Upcoming Features and Improvements

pageBlocks.byLine: Welcome to EagleEye's public roadmap! This is a live document and will be updated regularly

items.title: Email insights from Microsoft 365
items.description: Connect your Microsoft 365 tenant and EagleEye scans your email every night. It can also scan your past emails, so your reports start with history, not a blank page.

items.title: Customer Portal
items.description: Develop a self-service portal where customers can access Power BI reports for email insights, manage tags for better categorization, and track email synchronization jobs.

items.title: Install from Azure Marketplace
items.description: Install EagleEye into your own Azure subscription from the Azure Marketplace. Your data stays in your tenant, under your control.

items.title: GitHub Integration
items.description: Bring your GitHub issues and pull requests into EagleEye, so they are tagged and reported on like your email.

items.title: Connect your AI assistant (MCP)
items.description: Ask Claude or Copilot about your EagleEye email and GitHub reports directly. Read-only, you sign in with your Microsoft work account, and an administrator turns it on.

items.title: Team mailboxes
items.description: Reports on the mailboxes your team shares with customers, such as support@ and sales@, by mailbox and by thread rather than by person, including how quickly replies go out and which emails are still waiting for one.
